_readme: The only values in this repository that come from outside it. Each console hands out a token,
you paste it here, and the build puts it in the <head> of every page. An empty string emits
nothing, so an unregistered console costs a meta tag rather than a wrong one.
google-site-verification  search.google.com/search-console      finds the site on its own, this only unlocks the reports
msvalidate.01            bing.com/webmasters                    Bing, and through it DuckDuckGo, Ecosia and Yahoo
naver-site-verification  searchadvisor.naver.com                REQUIRED: Yeti does not crawl an unregistered domain, so Korea sees nothing without it
baidu-site-verification  ziyuan.baidu.com                       needs a Baidu account, which needs a Chinese mobile number
yandex-verification      webmaster.yandex.com                   not a target market, but free and it costs one line
The IndexNow key is not a token from anybody. The protocol says the key is whatever you
generate, and hosting it at keyLocation is itself the proof of ownership, so this one works
